productDescription: The chlodi-lyser is an amperometric sensor for monitoring chlorine dioxide. It is ideal for all kinds of water treatment and produces stable readings even at high fluctuations of pH, temperature and flow.

productImageUrlAltText: chlori-lyser Free & Total Chlorine Physical Sensor
productDescription: The chlori-lyser is a revolutionary pH- and flow-independent sensor for monitoring free chlorine or total chlorine. Its internal buffer electrolyte allows pH-independent measurement between pH 4 to 9, and its 3-electrode system provides extremely stable readings. High precision is ensured even at high fluctuations of pH, temperature and flow.

The condu-lyser is a maintenance-free and long-term stable probe for online measurement of conductivity, automatically compensated with temperature. It can be mounted directly in the media or in a flow cell providing high precision by either conductive or inductive measurement.

The hyper-lyser is an amperometric sensor for monitoring hydrogen peroxide. It is ideal for all kinds of water treatment and produces stable readings even at high fluctuations of pH, temperature and flow. Strong surfactants are tolerated.

productImageUrlAltText: nitro-lyser V3 Nitrate & Turbidity Spectrometer Probe
productDescription: The nitro-lyser measures nitrate concentration, turbidity and solids concentration. The displayed nitrate concentration is not affected by cross-influences from other substance groups such as organic carbon or total solids.

The oxi-lyser is an optical multiparameter probe that measures the concentration of dissolved oxygen (DO) and the temperature directly in the water. It does not need a minimum flow to produce accurate readings and integrates the temperature measurement for online correction. Minimal conventional calibration and virtually zero maintenance.

Measurement of ozone in water is what the ozo-lyser is optimized for. This member of the spectrometer family is optimized to determine concentrations of ozone dissolved in water online and in situ. It offers an alternative to classical electrochemical ozone sensors.

The peroxy-lyser is an amperometric sensor for monitoring peracetic acid. It is ideal for a variety of water treatment and produces stable readings even at high fluctuations of pH, temperature and flow.

productImageUrlAltText: pH-lyser pH and Temperature Physical Sensor
productDescription: The pH-lyser is designed for the real-time measurement of pH and temperature directly in the medium or in a flow-cell. Operates under tough conditions and in water with very low conductivity.

productImageUrlAltText: uv-lyser V3 Turbidity & Total Suspended Solids Spectrometer Probe
productName: uv-lyser V3 Turbidity & Total Suspended Solids Spectrometer Probe
productDescription: The uv-lyser monitors turbidity, total suspended solids and up to 4 individual wavelengths between 200 and 720 nm. Ideal for surface water, groundwater, drinking water and wastewater applications.
The multi-lyser combines the carbo-lyser and nitro-lyser and its ability to measure organic carbon and nitrate (NO3-N/NO3) for surface water, groundwater, drinking water and wastewater.
